systems.default: You are Qwen, created by Alibaba Cloud. You are a helpful assistant.

clock_definition: Mean log probability mass of comma+two-newlines token family at zero-based assistant phase 15 mod 16 minus other phases.
control_generation: All three stronger controls: copy items, default system only.

scoring.copy: Exact equality after surrounding whitespace removal; EOS required. Also record target containment as a secondary descriptive metric.
scoring.math: Last FINAL: integer equals target; EOS required. No model judge, no execution.
scoring.marker: At least one generated token whose decoded text includes comma followed by two newlines.
scoring.truncation: Length-capped answers count as incorrect; no adaptive extension.

scope: Small targeted validation; not a benchmark or safety certification. Fresh inputs are authored before inference; head selection and period are inherited, not rediscovered. No key-channel experiments or new training. No downstream generated code is executed.
